name: B10-0071/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Brutal repression against protesters in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Iran's violent crackdown on nationwide protests that began in late December 2025, where security forces killed thousands of demonstrators and cut off internet and phone networks. It calls on the European Union to impose new sanctions on Iranian officials responsible, to press Iran to stop the killings and release detained protesters, and to protect Iranians in Europe from threats and intimidation by the Iranian regime. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and demands; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to prepare new sanctions on Iranian officials and to strictly enforce existing ones.
- It affects Iran's leadership, security forces, and Iranians in Europe facing threats or deportation.
- Next, EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
